title: Personal Training Consultation - Amber
description: Initial Consultation The program begins with an initial consultation with a personal trainer. The initial consult consists of a 1.5 hour session in which the personal trainer will evaluate your current level of fitness, discuss and help you set goals and create a plan to get you closer to those fitness goals. Please dress in comfortable work-out clothes, wear indoor gym shoes, and bring a water bottle. Policies Participants in the Personal Trainer Program must have current memberships at the PWSC Health & Fitness Center or pay the daily rate when working with the personal trainer.
